description: Migrate datasecurity rules for all data models from source to target.

examples.user_query: Migrate all datasecurity rules for all data models, providing progress updates.
examples.notes: This call migrates datasecurity rules for all data models from the source to the target environment, while providing progress updates via the specified callback function.

examples.user_query: How can I migrate all datasecurity rules for every data model?
examples.notes: This call migrates datasecurity rules for all data models from the source to the target environment. No progress callback is provided in this case.

examples.user_query: Migrate all datasecurity rules without any progress updates.
examples.notes: This call performs the migration of datasecurity rules for all data models without emitting any progress updates.

description: Migrate row-level datasecurity rules for specific data models from source to target.

datamodel_ids.description: Data model OIDs to migrate. Provide either this or ``datamodel_names``.

datamodel_names.description: Data model titles to migrate. Provide either this or ``datamodel_ids``.

examples.user_query: Migrate row-level security rules for data models with IDs 'dm_12345' and 'dm_67890'.
examples.notes: This call migrates row-level security rules for the specified data models identified by their OIDs. Use this when you know the exact IDs of the data models to migrate.

examples.user_query: How can I migrate row-level security rules for the data models named 'Sales Data' and 'Marketing Data'?
examples.notes: This call migrates row-level security rules for the specified data models identified by their names. Use this when you know the titles of the data models to migrate.

examples.user_query: Migrate row-level security rules for the data model with ID 'dm_54321'.
examples.notes: This call migrates row-level security rules for a single data model identified by its OID. Use this when you need to migrate rules for a specific data model and have its ID.
